CustomField.description: True while Last Name still holds the reserved New Lead Wizard placeholder "Needs to Identify - {Company}". Detection ignores case, leading/trailing whitespace and spacing within the prefix. "Needs to Identify" is reserved text: do not use it as a real surname. Used by validation rule Placeholder_Name_Conversion_Block_CC to block conversion until a real name is entered.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked while the contact's real name is still unknown (Last Name begins with the reserved text "Needs to Identify"). Enter the real First and Last Name to clear it. The Lead cannot be converted while this is ticked.
CustomField.label: Contact Name Unknown
